verdict.rationale: The firm has a dedicated cyber-security page saying its international team helps clients "anticipate, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents," which covers the incident-response core. Its data protection and privacy page shows related privacy expertise, but neither page documents regulator-facing breach work. Missing for 10: explicit breach-notification or regulator-engagement (e.g. data protection authority) work, detail on incident-response services, and independent corroboration.
